snippet.title: Pragmata Developer Interview - Future Games Show gamescom 2025
snippet.description:
Pragmata is a puzzle-hacking action game from Capcom, and during the Future Games Show at gamescom, we got the inside scoop about this space station adventure from the game's developers. It's coming to PC, PlayStation and Xbox in 2026.

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #pragmata
